findings.text: non-blocking: the run owner's session is read only from live pointers, so a terminal run's scratch, the days-old other-session case the section measured, is reported with an empty session and the coordinator still needs a census; the test writes live pointers for both runs so this case is untested.

non-blocking: held = bool(holders) reads _processes_holding's None, which its docstring calls a scan failure that proves nothing either way, as nobody holds it, so a lander tree can be reported reclaimable when /proc was unreadable.
non-blocking: the detail line's reclaimable-bytes figure sums every owner's bytes, including held lander trees and live runs' scratch, so it overstates what a coordinator can reclaim now.

non-blocking: LANDER_TREE_PREFIX = "landing-base" restates landing_measure.py:1731 BASE_TREE_PREFIX = "landing-base-"; if the owner's prefix changes, the refusal silently stops recognising lander trees and files them as generic paths.

non-blocking: garbage_collect_scratch already enumerates the same scratch children with run_id and bytes, and gc.py:1607 already carries a ledger session, so the new function is a second enumerator of one population rather than an extension of that owner.

non-blocking: the existing test that already drives this refusal through crew dispatch was in neither the baseline nor the after arm, though the done_when asks for arms for every tests/ file reaching the changed modules.

non-blocking: tree_size_bytes is called with no limit for every scratch child on a refusal that fires exactly when /tmp is full, so the refusal can walk a whole git worktree of tens of thousands of files each time.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit (82e71063 the owners payload and the three doors; 682320c4 and 6a8d84b0 the evidence fragment's revision and summary lines); the change is the refusal payload, the resume-door headroom check, the review and resume JSON handlers, the conftest exclusion and the three-refusal test.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_scratch_floor_is_announced_with_its_owners.py building the section's scratch root and asserting all three refusals; the manifest records the scoped gate at 61 passed and the negative control at 3 failed, EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal, the refusal half of plan section 43, is that a dispatch, a crew resume and a review dispatch refused at the scratch floor each answer with JSON naming the free bytes, the floor and the reclaimable bytes by owner; reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:939 reclaimable_scratch_by_owner builds the breakdown and dispatch_launch.py:1026 attaches it to the refusal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states 58 passed at 8953532a (baseline), 61 passed at 82e71063 (scoped gate, 38.13s) and 61 at head (after suite, 38.99s), names its logs, and records an outside_scope note that the scratch-tree header lines lack module.__file__ and the resolved cwd.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff 8953532a..6a8d84b0 changes seven paths, all inside the eight declared write paths; the declared figure directory is unused and nothing outside the declared scope is touched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_scratch_floor_is_announced_with_its_owners.py:102 fails with KeyError when reclaimable_by_owner is removed, as the recorded negative control shows, but no assertion covers a terminal run's owning session.
justifications.evidence: the scoped gate log records 61 passed and EXIT=0 at 82e71063 and the negative control records 3 failed and EXIT=1, but neither suite arm ran tests/test_dispatch_refuses_without_tmp_headroom.py:102, the existing test of this same refusal.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:939 follows the module's lazy-import and best-effort idiom and carries no plan or ticket label, though line 901 restates landing_measure.py:1731 BASE_TREE_PREFIX.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1000 reads a run's owning session only from live pointers, so a terminal run's scratch carries an empty session, which is the days-old other-session population the section measured.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:939 reuses tree_size_bytes, gc._processes_holding and runs.list_live but re-enumerates the scratch population reckon/crew/gc.py:2087 garbage_collect_scratch already owns rather than extending that owner with a session field.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the seven changed paths lies within the declared write paths listed in the manifest, and no out-of-scope path appears in the diff.
